name: index
description: Index the code a directory's mod.lm says its services are made of, with their exports and links; on a workspace's, every repository it composes. Without one, every supported file, with a warning. Rarely needed: every other tool refreshes the index of the current directory first.

path.description: Directory to index, relative to the current one. Defaults to the current directory.

name: search_symbols
description: Find definitions (functions, methods, classes, interfaces) by name or qualified name, with an id for each to pass to the other tools. Faster and more exact than grepping for `def`/`func`/`class`.

query.description: Text to find in names and qualified names.

exact.description: Match the whole name instead of any part of it.

path.description: Only symbols whose file path contains this text.

name: outline
description: List every definition in a file, nested, with ids: a quick map of a file before reading it.

file.description: Path relative to the current directory.

name: references
description: Every place that uses a symbol (calls, imports, type uses), resolved by a language server, each with the function it sits in. Use instead of grep/rg to find callers or the impact of a change: other symbols with the same name and mentions in comments or strings are left out.

symbol.description: A name (`delete`), a qualified name (`Router.delete`), an id from search_symbols as shown (`#415`, or `#repo:415` in a workspace), or an export's address from a description (`services.api.createCharge`, or `#repo:services.api.createCharge` in a workspace).

path.description: Only symbols whose file path contains this text.

refresh.description: Ask the language server again instead of using a stored answer.

name: definition
description: Where the symbol used at a file position is defined: the function a call goes to, the class a name refers to, through imports and aliases.

file.description: Path relative to the current directory.

refresh.description: Ask the language server again instead of using a stored answer.

name: implementations
description: What implements an interface or interface method, or overrides a method. Text search cannot answer this reliably.

symbol.description: A name (`delete`), a qualified name (`Router.delete`), an id from search_symbols as shown (`#415`, or `#repo:415` in a workspace), or an export's address from a description (`services.api.createCharge`, or `#repo:services.api.createCharge` in a workspace).

path.description: Only symbols whose file path contains this text.

refresh.description: Ask the language server again instead of using a stored answer.

name: signature
description: A symbol's declaration as written, plus the language server's description (inferred types, documentation), without reading the whole file.

symbol.description: A name (`delete`), a qualified name (`Router.delete`), an id from search_symbols as shown (`#415`, or `#repo:415` in a workspace), or an export's address from a description (`services.api.createCharge`, or `#repo:services.api.createCharge` in a workspace).

path.description: Only symbols whose file path contains this text.

refresh.description: Ask the language server again instead of using a stored answer.

name: graph
description: The call graph around a symbol: what uses it (callers) and what it uses (callees), to a depth, as a tree with each node's file and line. Use to see how a change spreads or how a request reaches a function. From a workspace, `workspace` follows callers into other repositories through the operations a handler serves.

symbol.description: A name (`delete`), a qualified name (`Router.delete`), an id from search_symbols as shown (`#415`, or `#repo:415` in a workspace), or an export's address from a description (`services.api.createCharge`, or `#repo:services.api.createCharge` in a workspace).

path.description: Only symbols whose file path contains this text.

refresh.description: Ask the language server again instead of using a stored answer.

direction.description: Which way to follow uses. Default: both.

depth.description: How many uses away to go. Default: 2.

source.description: `lsp` (default) asks the language server: precise. `names` matches names in the indexed files: instant but approximate, and blind to files outside the index.

max_nodes.description: The most nodes to include. Default: 200.

workspace.description: A workspace mod.lm: follow callers out of the repository through the operations their handlers serve. Takes as long as a check.

across.description: With `workspace`, how many calls from other repositories to follow. Default: 1, the code calling the operations.

only.description: Only symbols of these kinds besides the symbol itself, comma-separated, such as `function,method` for the calls without the fields and types used.

name: check
description: Checks that repositories still agree, and that what a change adds is wired up: callers against the operations they call and their schemas, an operation added with no route or no caller, a route added that no spec declares, and the requirements and behaviors a mod.lm declares. Call it with `change` after editing a repository to see what the edit breaks or leaves unwired; uncommitted edits count. Behaviors may run their checkers, which run code.

manifest.description: The workspace's mod.lm. Default: mod.lm in the current directory.

change.description: The repository that changed, as the workspace names it, such as `billing`.

base.description: The commit before the change. Default: where the checked-out commit left the default branch, so a branch's commits and uncommitted edits are checked together.

head.description: The commit with the change. Default: the working directory, uncommitted changes included.

level.description: How strict to be; overrides the workspace's level.

no_run.description: Run no checkers: behaviors use kept evidence only.

select.description: Run only this: a check of the mod.lm, or one behavior or requirement by name or address, such as `passes_on_retriable` or `lemma.http.operation_without_consumer`. Much faster than everything when iterating on one behavior.

links.description: Also list every link between repositories.

name: verify
description: Checks that a description still matches the code: patterns that match no file, documents that do not exist, operations and anchors that do not resolve, renames that did not happen. Takes as long as a full check; run it when a description changes, not after every edit. Never compares commits: `check` does that.

module.description: The entry module. Default: mod.lm in the current directory.

links.description: Also list every link, declared and inferred.
